audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty tag FAV / 7.5-10 matches the 53.28% win rate over 3585 games; kept.
audit.why: Ornn's lane is favoured but not free — Karma outranges him with Inner Flame (950) and roots with Focused Resolve.
audit.corrected: diff FAV and diffRating 7.5/10 left as written; prose reworded to name the real abilities and Karma's correct pronouns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart contradicted the packet and the already-audited mirror: rows 0, 1 and 4 read Karma / Skill / Karma.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill, Ornn, Ornn, Ornn, Ornn, Ornn, Ornn, and the karma__ornn mirror already flipped rows 0, 1 and 4 to Skill / Ornn / Ornn. whys[4] on this page already described R as a guaranteed kill window while win[4] said Karma.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1 and 4 proposed in matched full/content pairs as Skill, Ornn, Ornn.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere, and the decisive interaction was never stated.
audit.why: Focused Resolve is 12s flat at every rank, roots only if the tether is not broken, and cannot cancel Bellows Breath. Volcanic Rupture's pillar is terrain, so Ornn supplies his own wall for Searing Charge (14s at rank 1) — he never needs a lane wall.
audit.corrected: Trade lines now state the pillar-as-wall and the root-cannot-cancel-W interaction with the 12s and 14s numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds note despite Mantra-W healing Karma.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal: Mantra Focused Resolve heals her and extends the root, which decides extended trades.

audit.whatIsWrong: Karma referred to as "him/his" in several fields.
audit.why: Karma is female; the page reads as generated filler.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed in the rewritten fields.

edits.before: Q-poke and AA-trade — your base stats are quietly elite. Identify how Karma contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Q-poke and AA-trade — your base stats are quietly elite. Neither of you has an all-in, so last-hit outside her 950-range Inner Flame.

edits.before: W brittle turns every trade into bonus %HP damage. Only take the trade when Karma's Focused Resolve is down.
edits.after: Bellows Breath Brittles her and cannot be cancelled — Focused Resolve's root does not stop it, so level 2 is yours.

edits.before: Call of the Forge God re-engages a whole fight — and your forge prints item leads. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Karma's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Call of the Forge God is a long-range double knock-up into Brittle — Mantra shields and roots, but it cannot stop an engage she has no dash to leave.

edits.before: You have no shield and low HP at level 1, but she has no all-in either — just last-hit and respect her Q poke range.
edits.after: You have no shield and low HP at level 1, but she has no all-in either — last-hit outside Inner Flame's 950 range.

edits.before: Your W comes online and its unstoppable percent-HP fire and shield outpace her single Q's poke at level 2.
edits.after: W's percent-HP fire and shield outpace Inner Flame, and Focused Resolve's root cannot cancel it at level 2.

edits.before: Weather the poke — brittle-proc him on the Focused Resolve cooldown and out-item the lane. Ornn wins the Focused Resolve cooldown windows.
edits.after: Weather Inner Flame — Brittle her on the 12s Focused Resolve cooldown and out-item the lane. Ornn wins every window her root is down.

edits.before: Brittle-proc him on the Focused Resolve cooldown and out-item the lane. Track Focused Resolve before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Brittle her on the 12s Focused Resolve cooldown and out-item the lane. Track that root before every commit and keep the wave on your side.

edits.before: Q the pillar behind Karma, E-dash through it for the knockup when his answer is down, and W-brittle the trade for the proc.
edits.after: Q the pillar behind Karma, E into it for the knockup, then W-Brittle and proc — her root cannot cancel Bellows Breath.

edits.before: E-dashing with no terrain in the line — no knockup means you delivered yourself to his combo for free.
edits.after: E with no terrain in the line — no knockup, and you stand in her tether for its full 14s cooldown.

edits.before: Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Her tether roots at the end, breaks on line of sight, and is 12s flat. Engage once it is spent.

edits.before: That is Karma's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Refuse it — hug the wave, break sight on your pillar, and half her win condition dies.

edits.before: E-dashing with no terrain in the line — no knockup means you delivered yourself to his combo for free.
edits.after: Brittle from W amplifies your follow-up — always land the E knockup into it, or the trade is worth half.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Focused Resolve: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If behind, farm safe and let your spikes re-open the lane.
edits.after: Trade around Focused Resolve's 12s: when it is down, run the full pattern. Mantra-W heals her through chip, so buy Grievous Wounds before you commit to long fights.

notes: Mirror karma__ornn already existed and its chart (Skill/Ornn x6) was reused rather than re-derived. Ornn's Q pillar is terrain, so Searing Charge never needs a lane wall — stated on both sides now. Karma was repeatedly called 'him' on this page; fixed in every field I touched, but the same error remains in fields I did not need to rewrite (breakdown.feeding, breakdown.late, report[12].t).
